name: Draven
text: Keywords: Quick Attack. When I'm summoned or strike: Create a Spinning Axe in hand. Level up: I've struck with 2+ total Spinning Axes.

name: Possession
text: Steal an enemy follower this round. (Can't play if you have 6 allies or landmarks already.)

name: Slotbot
text: When I'm summoned or Round Start: Grant me +0|+1 for each card you drew last round, then shuffle my stats.

name: Gangplank
text: Keywords: Overwhelm. When I'm summoned, summon a Powder Keg. Level up: You've damaged the enemy Nexus in 5+ different rounds.

name: Nautilus
text: Keywords: Tough, Fearsome. Level up: When you are Deep. When I level up, copy Tossed allies that cost 4+ into your deck.

name: Playful Trickster
text: Remove an attacking ally from combat to Rally.

name: Sejuani
text: Keywords: Overwhelm. Play: Give an enemy Frostbite and Vulnerable this round. Level up: You've damaged the enemy Nexus in 5+ different rounds.

name: Tahm Kench
text: When I'm summoned or Round Start: Create an An Acquired Taste in hand. Level up: I've Captured 3+ units. When I level up, Obliterate my Captured enemies and release my allies.

name: Taric
text: Keywords: Support. Support: Give me and my supported ally Tough this round. Copy the last spell you played on only me this round onto that ally (It can't be copied again). Level up: I've seen you target or support allies 7+ times.

name: Out Of The Way
text: For the rest of the game, allied "this round" buffs (except Barrier) are permanent. Draw 1.

name: Mountain Sojourners
text: Keywords: Support. Support: Grant my supported ally +2|+2. If it has Support, grant its supported ally +2|+2 and continue for each supported ally in succession.

name: Patched Porobot
text: While in hand, I have a random keyword that changes each round. When I'm summoned, grant me this keyword.

name: Give It All
text: Grow all allies' Power and Health to the highest Power or Health among allies. Grant all allies allied keywords.

name: Go Hard
text: Drain 1 from a unit. Create 2 copies of Go Hard in your deck. Every third time this happens, transform all copies of me everywhere into Pack Your Bags.

name: Feel The Rush
text: Summon 2 different, random champions from your hand and deck. Grow their stats up to 10|10.

name: Production Surge
text: To play, spend all your mana. Summon random Turrets whose total cost equals the mana spent.

name: Defective Swapbot
text: Play: Swap my stats with another unit.

name: Volunteer Elnuk
text: When I'm summoned, create a random Elnuk in the top 6 cards of your deck.

name: Reaver's Row
text: Keywords: Countdown, Landmark. When I count down, summon a random 1 cost follower. Countdown 2: Grant 1 cost allies +2|+1 and Fearsome.

name: Ruined Rex
text: Play: Play Cannon Barrage on randomly targeted enemies for each card you've drawn this round, up to 6 times.

name: Black Rose Spy
text: Reputation: When I'm summoned, transform me into an exact copy of the strongest ally that struck this round.

name: Eye of the Ra-Horak
text: Keywords: Countdown, Landmark. Countdown 1: Stun the 2 weakest enemies. Daybreak: Summon a copy of me with Countdown 2.

name: Swiftwing Flight
text: Keywords: Challenger. Play: Create a Silverwing Vanguard, Blinding Assault, or Fleetfeather Tracker in hand. Attack: Give other Challenging allies +1|+1 this round.

name: Kennen
text: Keywords: Quick Attack. When I'm summoned, create a Mark of the Storm in hand. Level up: You've summoned the same ally 5+ times.

name: Poppy
text: Attack: Grant allies with equal or less power than me +1|+1. Level up: I've attacked with allies 3 times.

name: The Bandle Tree
text: Keywords: Landmark. Round Start: Create a follower from a new region in hand. Then, if I've seen allies from 10 regions, win the game.

name: Treasured Trash
text: Fill your hand with random cards. They cost 0 and areFleeting. You can only play 3 more cards this round.

name: Curious Shellfolk
text: When you pick a non-champion card from randomly selected options, create a copy in hand and reduce its cost by 1.

name: Children of the Forest
text: Recall an ally, or spend 8 mana to summon Ephemeral copies of the 3 strongest followers you've Recalled this game.

name: Memory's Cloak
text: Pick an ally being targeted by enemy Fast spells, Slow spells, or Skills with only 1 allied target. Stop them.

name: Sion
text: Keywords: Overwhelm. When I'm discarded, grant your strongest ally Overwhelm and place me into your deck. I have +1|+0 for each card you've discarded this game (Max +7|+0). Level up: You've discarded or summoned 35+ Power.

name: Avatar of the Tides
text: Keywords: Imbue. If you would get a mana gem, instead refill your spell mana. When you play a spell, create in hand a random spell that costs 3 or less and grant it Fleeting.

name: Catalogue of Regrets
text: Keywords: Landmark. Round Start: Create in hand a Fleeting copy of a non-Fleeting spell you played last round.

name: Senna
text: Keywords: Quick Attack, Missing Translation. When I'm summoned or Attack: Create a Darkness in hand if you don't have one. Your damage and kill spells accelerate to Fast. Level up: I've seen you kill 3+ units with spells or an allied Lucian die.

name: Camphor, the Doubt
text: When I'm summoned, if you've targeted allies in 4 different rounds, grant me Spellshield, Overwhelm, and Challenger.

name: Pantheon
text: Keywords: Overwhelm, Barrier. Level up: You've targeted allies in 5+ different rounds.

name: Legion Deserter
text: Keywords: Fearsome. I gain all allied everywhere buffs.

name: Celestial Trifecta
text: Invoke a low, medium, and high cost Celestial card.

name: Mystic Vortex
text: Keywords: Countdown, Landmark. When I'm summoned or when I count down, plant 3 Chimes in your deck. Countdown 2: Draw 1.

name: Starhound Pack
text: My Fated buffs are granted to allied Starhound Packs everywhere.

name: Salvaged Scrap
text: To play, discard up to 2 cards. Create that many followers from your regions that cost 1 more and reduce their costs by 1.

name: Wharf Rat
text: Keywords: Overwhelm. I have +1|+0 for each different round you've damaged the enemy Nexus.

name: Void Abomination
text: Keywords: Evolve. When I'm summoned, grant me all positive keywords allies have had this game. When an ally has a new positive keyword, grant it to me.

name: Glory's Call
text: I cost 2 less for each different Ascended ally you've summoned this game. Manifest a card from the Emperor's Deck with cost 9 or less.

name: Voidling
text: Keywords: Evolve. While in hand, I have a random keyword that changes each round. When I'm summoned, grant me this keyword.

name: Hate Spike
text: Kill an ally to deal 3 to a unit and if Evelynn started in your deck, summon a random Husk.

name: Eternal Dancers
text: Keywords: Hallowed. Attack: Revive an attacking Ephemeral copy of the strongest dead ally other than Eternal Dancers with my power or less.

name: Ornn
text: Keywords: Tough. Play: Equip me with an exact copy of an ally's equipment or the strongest equipment from hand. Attack: Forge me twice. Level up: An ally has struck for 8+ damage in one strike.

name: Priestess Of Desert Light
text: Round Start: Deal 4 to me. Draw a champion and grant it +2|+2. If your deck started with 6+ different champions, summon it instead.

name: Fish Fight
text: An ally and an enemy strike each other, or an Equipped ally strikes an enemy, then is unequipped.

name: Wraith of Echoes
text: Round End: For each ally that died this round, grant all allied copies of it everywhere +1|+1.

name: Quietus
text: Kill a unit with total Power and Health of 4 or less, or destroy a unit's equipment.

name: Samira
text: Keywords: Quick Attack, Plunder. Plunder or strike: Create a Flair in hand if you don't already have one. Level up: I've seen you play 6 cards. Resets when you start a round with the attack token.

name: Prize Fight
text: An ally and an enemy strike each other. They can't drop below 1 Health from this strike.

name: Secret Keeper
text: When I'm summoned, create at the bottom of your deck two random level 2 champions that aren't in your hand, deck, or play.

name: Sacrificial Scholar
text: Keywords: Last Breath. Last Breath: Create in hand copies of the first 3 spells you played on me.

name: Anura & Froop
text: Keywords: Missing Translation. Allies that have a different subtype than other allies in play cost 1 less.

name: Deck Hunter
text: Play: Manifest a follower that has a different subtype than allies in play.

name: Ingvar the Younger
text: Play: Pick an ally. Grant it and all other allies that share a subtype with it +1|+1 or Manifest a follower that shares a subtype with it.

name: Ferocious Fluffs
text: Keywords: Impact. When I'm summoned, grant other allies that have subtypes +1|+1 and Impact.

name: Janna
text: Play: Updraft 2 to draw 2 at the next Round Start. Each round, the first 3 times you draw a card, reduce its cost by 1 this round. Level up: I've seen you play 8 cost reduced cards.

name: Howling Gale
text: Deal 2 to a unit. Increase my damage by 1 for each other card you've played this round, up to 3 times.

name: Bladebound Berserker
text: When you play a Slow spell that targets a single ally, copy it onto me.

name: Clash of Giants
text: Summon 2 random Titanic followers. I cost 1 less for each Elemental spell or Skill you've played this game (max 10).

name: Alatis the Gallant
text: Keywords: Fury. Your Dragon Boons target all Dragon allies.

name: Lux: Illuminated
text: Keywords: Spirit, Support. Support: Grant my supported ally Spirit and give me Barrier this round. Level up: Allies have attacked with or have gained while attacking 20+ total positive keywords.

name: Dreamlight Alina
text: Keywords: Spirit. When I'm summoned, summon 5 Spritelings. For each one there isn't space for, grant the Weakest ally 2 Spirit instead.
